name: sequelize-typescript-generator
description: Automatically generates typescript models compatible with sequelize-typescript library (https://www.npmjs.com/package/sequelize-typescript) directly from your source database.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && npm run check-deps
scripts.test:postgres: docker compose --profile postgres up -d && TEST_DB_DIALECT=postgres tsx src/tests/integration/wait-for-db.ts && TEST_DB_DIALECT=postgres npm run test:integration; status=$?; docker compose --profile postgres down -v; exit $status
scripts.test:mysql: docker compose --profile mysql up -d && TEST_DB_DIALECT=mysql tsx src/tests/integration/wait-for-db.ts && TEST_DB_DIALECT=mysql npm run test:integration; status=$?; docker compose --profile mysql down -v; exit $status
scripts.test:mariadb: docker compose --profile mariadb up -d && TEST_DB_DIALECT=mariadb tsx src/tests/integration/wait-for-db.ts && TEST_DB_DIALECT=mariadb npm run test:integration; status=$?; docker compose --profile mariadb down -v; exit $status
scripts.test:mssql: docker compose --profile mssql up -d && TEST_DB_DIALECT=mssql tsx src/tests/integration/wait-for-db.ts && TEST_DB_DIALECT=mssql npm run test:integration; status=$?; docker compose --profile mssql down -v; exit $status
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:sqlite
scripts.dev: tsx src/bin/cli.ts -D mysql -u root -x mysql -d dbtest --dialect-options '{"timezone": "local"}' --case const:camel --clean --logs

author: Ludovico Fabbri
